description: RaptorQ durability coverage requirements for long-lived V1 artifacts

fixtures.rationale: Fixture corruption would silently invalidate conformance guarantees

conformance_reports.description: Conformance gate reports, parity reports, and policy artifacts
conformance_reports.rationale: Key evidence artifacts for oracle parity, security, stability, and TTL claims

reliability_budgets.description: CI reliability budget and coverage reports
reliability_budgets.rationale: Corrupted budgets or CI reports could mask reliability regressions

performance_baselines.description: Top-level performance regression baselines and gate reports
performance_baselines.rationale: Baseline corruption would invalidate perf gate comparisons

e2e_logs.description: E2E forensic logs - ephemeral test evidence
e2e_logs.rationale: Regenerated on every test run; triplet would be stale immediately

schemas.rationale: Version-controlled source files, not generated artifacts

phase2c_manifests.rationale: Historical migration artifacts; integrity verified at extraction time

performance_pass_scratch.rationale: Historical per-pass microbenchmark logs; top-level baselines and gates are covered

coverage_target.notes: All required artifacts must have a fresh sidecar + scrub + proof triplet matching current on-disk SHA-256
